Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/14/Text/11] At T2, two values and one contextual variable were associated with affective outcomes above and beyond T1 levels and associations, indicating that their effects on well-being became stronger over time. In the integrated longitudinal model, T2 positive affect was [/page/15/Text/1] significantly predicted by T2 transcendence values (b = .15, z(371) = 3.34, p\.05); T2 negative affect was predicted by T2 enhancement values (b = .19, z(371) = 3. 91, p\.05); and number of illnesses predicted both positive affect (b = -.07, z(371, 1-tailed) = 1.72, p\.05) and negative affect (b = .19, z(371) = 3.41, p\.05).
